threat_event: A&E staff send CUI drawings to construction field teams by commercial email or the PDPP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field release export; no enclave access for field recipients
treatment_plan: Remove field release; enclave access for recipients (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: The enclave fails a Level 2 (C3PAO) assessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSP outdated; allowlisting exceptions; one gateway component not FIPS-validated; field CUI training missing
existing_controls: Final Level 2 (Self) dated 2026-03-16 under counsel review
treatment_plan: Close all requirements that cannot be on a POA&M; independent re-test (group plan GR-03)

threat_event: A nation-state actor exfiltrates DoD facility designs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High-value design data; CUI copies outside the enclave widen exposure
treatment_plan: Enclave threat hunting quarterly; remove spilled copies

threat_event: A subconsultant without Level 2 status receives CUI
treatment_plan: Status check before award; enclave guest accounts for subconsultants without status

threat_event: Generative design assistant output that does not meet code is carried into sealed drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New tool; reviewers may trust output
regulatory_driver: State professional licensure rules; building codes
treatment_plan: Label AI-generated elements; checklist at sealing (P10)

threat_event: A&E cost estimators upload FCI or CUI cost data to the AI estimating assistant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One CUI-marked specification found in SYS-D6 in P07 testing
treatment_plan: Block federal project uploads from A&E until CUI screening is in place (P10)

threat_event: Client designs are exposed through open sharing links in the design collaboration service
A digital twin tenant isolation failure exposes one owner's facility data to another
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared application layer across 52 client tenants
existing_controls: Separate storage and keys per client

threat_event: Digital twin outage breaches the 99.5% availability commitment
treatment_plan: Warm standby in a second region

threat_event: Ransomware on design workstations or rendering compute halts design production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large GPU workstation fleet; plug-ins from many sources
existing_controls: EDR; version history in the collaboration service

threat_event: Clients pay A&E invoices to an attacker after receiving altered PDFs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Invoices carry remittance details in emailed PDFs
treatment_plan: Invoice delivery through the client portal; standing remittance letter

threat_event: A sealed drawing is changed after sealing without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Seal applied to PDF without integrity protection on some projects
treatment_plan: Digitally signed seals on all issued sets

threat_event: Specifications for federal projects name covered video surveillance or telecommunications products
treatment_plan: Use the group approved-manufacturer list in master specifications

threat_event: A departing designer takes CUI or client designs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports from commercial workstations not monitored

threat_event: Enclave virtual desktop capacity is exhausted near a submittal deadline
An A&E enclave incident on a design-build project is not reported to DoD in 72 hours or not passed to the prime
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Intercompany prime and subcontractor reporting roles not defined
existing_controls: DIBNet certificate held by the federal compliance office
treatment_plan: Define intercompany reporting in the notification matrix (group plan GR-04)

threat_event: Project images of client facilities are posted publicly
Designers access the enclave from homes and jobsites without required safeguards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alternate work site rules not written for jobsite trailers
existing_controls: Enclave access only from managed devices
